description: The App.tsx file defines the main React component for a trading visualization application. It manages state, sets up data fetching or mock data, transforms Plotly chart data, and renders a Chart component with the processed data. It also defines global window variables for external data interfacing.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component that initializes state, sets up data fetching, processes data, and renders the chart or loading indicator.

methods.name: transformData
methods.description: Transforms Plotly JSON data into a structure suitable for rendering, including setting global titles and annotations.
